# Support

## Getting help

- **Questions / troubleshooting / workflows / App Store Connect errors:** please start in **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mdo91/video-preview-appstore/discussions)** (that keeps Issues focused on actionable bugs/feature work).
  - Tips for writing a good post: [`DISCUSSIONS_WELCOME.md`](DISCUSSIONS_WELCOME.md)
- **Bug reports / well-scoped feature requests:** open a **[GitHub Issue](https://github.com/mdo91/video-preview-appstore/issues)**.

When possible, include:

- macOS version
- Xcode version
- What you expected to happen
- What happened instead
- Relevant logs or screenshots

## Scope

This project is maintained as an open-source utility. Response times may vary.
